title: optimize-operator input
description: A request to start, resume or inspect one operator's campaign: the operator, the budget a human granted, and the stop condition. No kernel code and no hypothesis is supplied; the campaign produces both.

mode.description: start opens a campaign after preflight, resume re-enters an open one, status reports without changing anything.

experiments.description: Experiments this campaign may spend; zero refuses the start.

target_attainment_pct.description: The campaign's stop target; 85 is the plan's suggested starting value.

noise_threshold.description: Measured A/A noise floor. Unknown is a preflight failure, not a zero.

last_round_gained.description: Whether the most recent round cleared the noise floor; false plus five rounds triggers the stop.

no_hypothesis_above_noise.description: Set by the orchestrator when no open route prices above the noise floor.

read_ledger.description: False keeps the run pure over its input, which is how the regression cases replay without a ledger.
